decisions.reason: The metro data centre network rests on owned fibre investment, has publicly reported adoption, and is central to the announced data centre and cloud direction, so commitment remains strong.
The number ordering portal is a low-cost software platform that fits the real-time provisioning direction, and dropping it would contradict earlier justifications.
Carrier pre-selection is a shrinking legacy service, but its regulatory ties, low running cost and the firm's prior decisions to retain it make persisting another year more likely than withdrawal.
Direct voice network connection builds on the established voice infrastructure and serves enterprise customers, and any weak results can still be attributed to temporary market conditions.
